desc:
[ ⚠️ THIS IS A BETA RELEASE! This game is still in active development, and not fully polished. ]
[ ⚠️ WARNING: This game has flashing lights, screen shakes and jumpscares! ]

Beatbox game, what else?

Project: Afternight is a casual, heavily customizable rhythm game inspired by Friday Night Funkin' (FNF), and its mods, with content from other games/media available as well. 
Get on a speaker to battle other players on nearly 4,000 different songs across several difficulties.

Best played on desktop, but mobile and console are also supported.
Join the community for news and sneak peeks!

- Credits to The Funkin' Crew for the original Friday Night Funkin' assets.
- Credits to various mod authors & musicians used can be seen in-game.

This game is not associated with SEGA, Konami, Behaviour Interactive, Ghost Ship Games, Steel Wool Studios, Ubisoft, Epic Games, EA, Capcom, Project Moon or any other brands mentioned in-game. All rights go to the mentioned.

badges.name: Welcome!
badges.desc:
Welcome to Project: Afternight! We hope you enjoy it here.

Moon Logo by Glubbee

badges.name: Where'd They Go?
badges.desc:
Beat any song with at least 70% accuracy with both "Fade In" and "Fade Out" modifiers enabled at once.
The song played must have at least 175 playable notes.

badges.name: Randomizer
badges.desc:
Beat any song with at least 70% accuracy with "Inverse Notes", "Random Note Scale", "Randomize Chart" and "Random Scroll Invert" modifiers all enabled at once.
The song played must have at least 175 playable notes.

badges.name: How Did We Get Here?
badges.desc:
Beat any song with at least 70% accuracy, with every modifier enabled at once (excluding Fades and rating modifiers).
The song played must have at least 175 playable notes.

badges.name: I AM THE SPEED
badges.desc:
Beat any song with at least 70% accuracy with "Speed Up on Miss" enabled on a song at 2x Speed.
The song played must have at least 175 playable notes.

badges.name: [COLLAB] Strategist
badges.desc:
Full combo any Blox Cards OST song on any difficulty.
This unlocks a unique reward in Blox Cards.
